title: Gobena and Kefale lead Ethiopian double at Hong Kong half marathon
weather: Hot and humid, up to 28°C, with wind on an undulating bridge course. The winner said the conditions made fast times difficult.

story.W: A close race: 12 seconds covered the first three. Wede Kefale won by seven seconds from Glenrose Xaba.
story.M: Addisu Gobena dominated and finished 56 seconds clear.

performances.name: Addisu GOBENA
performances.note: Dominated the race, passing 10 km in 28:43 and winning by 56 seconds, less than three months after his Sydney Marathon course record.

performances.name: Aliyi KASIM
performances.note: Second on his half marathon debut.

performances.name: Alex LENALEPISHO
performances.note: Third on his half marathon debut.

performances.name: Wede KEFALE
performances.note: First half marathon win in six attempts, in a tight finish; her 1:09:04 was well off her 1:05:21 best because of the heat.

performances.name: Glenrose XABA
performances.note: Second, seven seconds behind the winner.

dnf.name: Selemon BAREGA
dnf.note: The 2021 Olympic 10,000 m champion and a pre-race favourite did not finish; no reason given.

dnf.name: Grace NAWOWUNA
dnf.note: The defending champion did not finish; no reason given.
